Week 45: WhisperCPP

I will have a hackathon this weekend. But I will talk about whisper.cpp. It is a tool to transpile sound file into text. Whisper Desktop is a GUI for that. To use the model in code, can download it from huggingface

Nature of Code by Daniel Shiffman. I good book suggested by my teacher. Nice to read.
